title: 第九章：刺穿他们
content_zh:
汉克的话，让苏晓眼睛一亮。
他终于确定现在的时间点，是原著中出现过的一幕，是在焚烧废品终点站的三天前。
也就是说，在他任务的最大时限内，废品终点站将会被焚烧。
这对于苏晓来说无疑是个好消息，越是混乱，他的机会就越多，浑水才好摸鱼。
汉克向仓库外走去，好似想起什么，转头说道：“我们老大叫布兰登?欧卡，你现在也是侍卫队成员，怎么能不知道老大的姓名。”
苏晓轻笑一声，点头示意。
两人走出仓库，这时天色已经渐暗，街道上满是疲倦的行人。
通过闲聊苏晓打探到，之前见到的那位壮汉，也就是他现在的‘上司’布兰登?欧卡，已经担任侍卫首领将近十年的时间，人脉广泛，与王宫内大小官员都有所接触，甚至曾被国王召见。
汉克口中的这些话，苏晓并不是很相信，对方有拍马屁嫌疑。
布兰登?欧卡担任侍卫首领十年可能不假，但人脉广泛这一点还有待考证。
要知道，在一个职位停留十年的时间，也代表他这位‘上司’在王都混的不怎么样
就在汉克准备和苏晓道别离开时，苏晓主动开口。
“去喝一杯如何？今天我刚到王都，有许多事要向你请教。”
汉克故作为难状，但在苏晓的‘热邀’下，两人走进了一间酒屋。
几杯米酒过后，汉克脸色略红，满嘴酒气，话明显多了起来。
“我和你说，如果老大当初不是管不住下本身，现在早就进入王宫任职。
你说老大碰谁不好，非要碰……嗝~。”
汉克打了个酒嗝，话说到一半停下，仿佛发现自己说错什么。
苏晓端起酒杯，与汉克碰了一杯，在汉克仰头喝酒时，他手中的酒已经不翼而飞。
在这危险的任务世界中饮酒，无疑是找死行为，所以苏晓没饮下一滴酒水。

“算了，不说了，老大现在每天也活的潇洒，是欢乐街的常客，真让人羡慕。”
苏晓随便应付几句，又给汉克倒上一杯。
酒过三巡，时间到了晚上七点左右，苏晓与汉克在酒屋门口分开，街道上已经灯火通明。
苏晓点燃一支烟，烟雾渺渺间，他若有思索的看着远去的汉克。
对方给他提供了很多情报，而且到了夜晚，就是苏晓行动的时间。
单手按在腰间的刀柄上，苏晓拦下一名路人，那路人刚开始有些恼怒，但看清苏晓身穿侍卫队的制服后，明显畏惧起来。
“打听一下，欢乐街在哪。”
路人露出一个男人都懂的笑容，之后给苏晓指明方向。
这种笑容以及欢乐街这个名字，让苏晓想到，欢乐街是什么地方。
他这位‘上司’的精力还真是充沛。
-------------
华灯初上，一条粉色与红色灯光为主色调的街区内。
街道两侧是以双层或三层的尖顶建筑为主。顶端由琉璃瓦铺盖，门前挂着一盏盏圆形或方形灯笼。
轻缓的乐器声，与街道上的欢声笑语交织在一起，众多男女亲密的依偎在一起。
街边的楼阁上，依稀能看到一些衣着暴露，手中拿着细长烟斗的女人，这些女人正媚笑的站在阁楼上，意图吸引过完的客人。
这里是欢乐街，海贼世界的花街。
一栋楼阁的房顶，苏晓身穿黑衣蹲坐在上方，手中握着【斩龙闪】。
在进入海贼世界后，苏晓一直都没怎么出手，而在今晚，他要暗杀第一个目标，为完成任务做下铺垫。
一声大笑在街道上传来。
这有些熟悉的笑声，马上将苏晓的目光吸引，发出笑声的人，不正是他白天见过的那位‘上司’吗。

布兰登?欧卡身后跟着两名侍卫，正大摇大摆的走在欢乐街上。
来往的行人在看到布兰登?欧卡后，马上躲到一旁，神色有些拘谨。
“终于来了。”
苏晓藏身在房顶，紧跟着布兰登?欧卡等人。
没过多久，布兰登?欧卡等人走进一间楼阁内，苏晓穿行在黑夜中，来到那件楼阁顶端。
先是等待一会，苏晓从房顶跃下，落地无声，并且马上紧靠墙壁，以免被发现。
借助着夜色与昏暗灯光的掩护，苏晓开始一间间房间查探。
查探房间并不需要用眼睛，只凭声音就可以。
苏晓曾专门训练过这种能力，他还记得布兰登?欧卡的声音。
在查探三间房后，苏晓找到了他的目标，房间中有谈话声传来，是一男一女。
“你到底什么时候才能‘救我’，难道就忍心看我在这陪其他男人？”
“很快，很快，这里是左大臣的生意，不单是钱能解决的问题，我最近也在努力，左大臣那可是国王身边的人……。”
苏晓面无表情的听着房间中的两人谈话，但两人谈话的内容越来越‘肉麻’，让他眉头紧锁。
可现在还不是时候，苏晓要等欧卡最脆弱时候，给予他致命一击。
事情进展的很顺利，没过多久，房间中就传出阵阵喘息声。
苏晓缓缓将腰间的长刀出鞘，之后动作轻缓的推开窗，翻入房间内，没有发出丝毫声音。
房间内正有一男一女缠绕在一起，正在啪啪中。
苏晓之所以选择这种时机，是因为只有现在，欧卡才是最脆弱的。
每靠近欧卡一步，苏晓都是格外小心，仿佛捕食前猎豹般，走路悄无声息。
五米，三米，一米。

苏晓来到欧卡身后，缓缓举起手中的长刀，刀尖对准欧卡的后脑。
正在欧卡身下闭目享受的女人，不知为何眼睛突然睁开，看到了手持利刃的苏晓。
女人面露惊恐，下意识想发出尖叫，欧卡也注意到了女人那惊恐表情。
但，一切都太迟了。
双手反握刀柄，苏晓用尽全力向欧卡后脑刺去。
“噗嗤。”
长刀直接从欧卡的后脑贯穿，那锋利的刀尖，仿佛刺破一张纸般，从欧卡的口出刺出。
长刀去势不减，染血后的刀尖又刺穿欧卡身下女人的眼窝，之后深深没入女人身下的榻榻米中。
被长刀贯穿的两人，仿佛上岸的鱼一般，身体剧烈的抽动着，一个被伤到脊柱、口腔，另一个被刺穿脑髓，两人都无法喊出声，所以并没引起他人的注意。
苏晓的这一刀，经过精密计算。
如果只杀欧卡一人，那欧卡身|下的女人第一时间会发出尖叫，到时门口的侍卫冲入房间，苏晓的情况就危险了。
海贼世界平民的身体数值都很强，更何况是侍卫？
一刀两命，毫不留情，苏晓的杀人本领至于超过大部分杀手。
这也是为何，轮回乐园会选择他成为猎杀者。
猎杀者不单是天赋特殊就能担任，还要有杀人的胆量。
（现在是粉嫩新书，所以求推荐、
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
Hank’s words made Lidya Su’s eyes light up.
He finally determined that the current time point was a scene that appeared in the original work, three days before the waste burning terminal.
In other words, within the maximum time limit of his mission, the Scrap Terminal will be burned.
This is undoubtedly good news for Su Xiao. The more chaotic it is, the more opportunities he will have, and it is easier to fish in muddy waters.
Hank walked out of the warehouse and seemed to remember something. He turned around and said, "Our boss is Brandon Oka. You are also a member of the Guards now. How can you not know the boss's name?"
Lidya Su chuckled and nodded.
The two walked out of the warehouse. It was getting dark and the streets were full of tired pedestrians.
Through chatting, Su Xiao found out that the strong man he met before, his current 'boss' Brandon Oka, had been the leader of the guards for nearly ten years. He had extensive connections and had contacts with officials of all sizes in the palace. He had even been summoned by the king.
Su Xiao didn't quite believe what Hank said. He was suspected of flattering him.
It may be true that Brandon Oka has been the leader of the guards for ten years, but the fact that he has extensive connections remains to be verified.
You know, staying in one position for ten years also means that his 'boss' is not doing well in the capital.
Just when Hank was about to say goodbye to Lidya Su and leave, Lidya Su took the initiative to speak.
"How about a drink? I just arrived in the capital today and I have many things to ask you."
Hank was embarrassed to do so, but under Su Xiao's "warm invitation", the two walked into a wine house.
After a few glasses of rice wine, Hank's face turned slightly red, his mouth smelled of alcohol, and he obviously talked more.
"Let me tell you, if the boss hadn't been unable to control himself, he would have joined the palace by now.
You said it's not good for the boss to touch anyone, but he must touch... hiccup~. "
Hank burped and stopped mid-sentence, as if he realized he had said something wrong.
Su Xiao picked up the wine glass and clinked it with Hank. When Hank raised his head to drink, the wine in his hand had disappeared.
Drinking alcohol in this dangerous mission world is undoubtedly an act of seeking death, so Su Xiao did not drink a drop of wine.
"Forget it, let's not talk about it. The boss lives a cool life every day now and is a frequent visitor to Happy Street. It's really enviable."
Lidya Su said a few words casually and poured another drink for Hank.
After three rounds of drinking, it was around seven o'clock in the evening. Su Xiao and Hank separated at the door of the wine house. The streets were already brightly lit.
Su Xiao lit a cigarette, and in the hazy smoke, he looked thoughtfully at Hank who was walking away.
The other party provided him with a lot of information, and at night, it was Su Xiao's time to take action.
With one hand on the handle of the knife at her waist, Su Xiao stopped a passerby. The passerby was a little angry at first, but after seeing that Su Xiao was wearing a guard uniform, he became obviously afraid.
"Ask where the Happy Street is."
The passerby smiled like a man, and then pointed out the direction to Su Xiao.
This smile and the name Happy Street reminded Su Xiao of where Happy Street was.
His 'boss' is really full of energy.
-------------
At the beginning of the lanterns, there is a block with pink and red lights as the main colors.
Both sides of the street are dominated by double- or three-story spire buildings. The top is covered with glazed tiles, and round or square lanterns hang in front of the door.
The gentle sound of musical instruments was intertwined with the laughter and laughter on the street, and many men and women cuddled closely together.
In the pavilions on the street, you can vaguely see some scantily clad women holding slender pipes in their hands. These women are standing on the pavilions with charming smiles, trying to attract the guests who have finished their business.
This is Happy Street, the flower street of the pirate world.
On the roof of a pavilion, Su Xiao was squatting in black clothes, holding [Dragon Slaying Flash] in his hand.
After entering the world of pirates, Su Xiao has never taken any action, but tonight, he wants toAssassinate the first target to pave the way for completing the mission.
A loud laugh echoed down the street.
This somewhat familiar laughter immediately attracted Su Xiao's eyes. The person who laughed was the 'boss' he had seen during the day.
Brandon Oka was walking swaggeringly on Happy Street with two guards behind him.
Pedestrians who were passing by immediately hid aside after seeing Brandon Oka, looking a little reserved.
"It's finally here."
Su Xiao hid on the roof, followed closely by Brandon Oka and others.
Not long after, Brandon Oka and others walked into a pavilion. Su Xiao walked through the dark night and came to the top of the pavilion.
After waiting for a while, Su Xiao jumped from the roof, landed silently, and immediately clung to the wall to avoid being discovered.
Under the cover of night and dim lights, Su Xiao began to explore rooms one by one.
You don't need to use your eyes to explore a room, just your voice.
Su Xiao had specially trained this ability, and he still remembered Brandon Oka's voice.
After checking three rooms, Su Xiao found his target. There was a conversation in the room, between a man and a woman.
"When are you going to 'save me'? Can you bear to see me here with other men?"
"Soon, soon, this is Minister Zuo's business. Not only is it a problem that money can solve, I have also been working hard recently. Minister Zuo is a person close to the king..."
Su Xiao listened expressionlessly to the conversation between the two people in the room, but the content of the conversation between the two became more and more "disgusting", which made him frown.
But now is not the time. Su Xiao wants to wait for Ouka to be at his most vulnerable before giving him a fatal blow.
Things went smoothly, and before long, gasps could be heard in the room.
Su Xiao slowly unsheathed the long knife on her waist, then gently pushed open the window and entered the room without making any sound.
There was a man and a woman entangled in the room, having sex.
The reason why Su Xiao chose this time is because only now, Ouka is the most vulnerable.
Every time she took a step closer to Ouka, Su Xiao was extremely careful, walking quietly like a cheetah before hunting.
Five meters, three meters, one meter.
Su Xiao came behind Oka, slowly raised the long knife in his hand, and pointed the tip of the knife at the back of Oka's head.
The woman who was enjoying herself under Oka suddenly opened her eyes for some reason and saw Su Xiao holding a sharp blade.
The woman looked frightened and subconsciously wanted to scream. Oka also noticed the woman's frightened expression.
But, it's too late.
Holding the handle of the knife behind his back with both hands, Su Xiao stabbed Oka in the back of the head with all his strength.
"Pfft."
The long knife penetrated directly through the back of Ouka's head, and the sharp tip of the knife pierced out of Ouka's mouth as if it had pierced a piece of paper.
The force of the long knife continued unabated, and the blood-stained tip pierced the eye socket of the woman under Oka, and then sank deeply into the tatami under the woman.
The two people who were pierced by the long knife looked like fish on the beach, their bodies twitching violently. One was injured in the spine and mouth, and the other was pierced through the brain. Neither of them could scream, so they did not attract the attention of others.
Su Xiao's knife was carefully calculated.
If only Oka is killed, the woman under Oka will scream immediately. When the guards at the door rush into the room, Su Xiao's situation will be dangerous.
The physical stats of the civilians in the pirate world are very strong, let alone the bodyguards?
Killing two people with one blow, showing no mercy, Su Xiao's killing ability surpasses that of most killers.
This is why Samsara Paradise chose him to be its hunter.
Hunters not only have special talents to be able to take on the role, but they also have the courage to kill.
(This is a new pink book, so please recommend it.)
(Sanqi Chinese et)
